datasets.name: HR-GLDD landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: Meena et al. [10] developed HR-GLDD, the first high-resolution global landslide dataset... HR-GLDD consists of 1119 training and 355 testing image tiles

methods.name: SegMamba2D
methods.summary: A lightweight semantic segmentation network with an encoder-decoder structure. The encoder uses Mamba modules (based on structured state-space models) for multiscale feature extraction with linear computational complexity, while the decoder uses a multilayer perceptron for lightweight feature fusion.
methods.verbatim: Specifically, a landslide detection model named SegMamba2D with an encoder–decoder structure is proposed... The source code is available at https://github.com/xiaochuan-tang/SegMamba2D

reproducibility_assessment: The HR-GLDD landslide is publicly available, and the custom SegMamba2D code is available via a provided GitHub repository link.
